subject: Ciências
description_pt: Concluir, com base na análise de ilustrações e/ou modelos (físicos ou digitais), que os organismos são um complexo arranjo de sistemas com diferentes níveis de organização.

components.description_pt: Identificar níveis hierárquicos de organização de células a sistemas de órgãos em organismos multicelulares
components.description_en: Identify the hierarchical levels of organization from cells to organ systems within multicellular organisms
components.cc_component_description: Identify the hierarchical levels of organization from cells to organ systems within multicellular organisms

components.description_pt: Explicar como grupos de células organizadas em tecidos e órgãos formam subsistemas funcionais corporais
components.description_en: Explain how groups of cells organized into tissues and organs form functional body subsystems
components.cc_component_description: Explain how groups of cells organized into tissues and organs form functional body subsystems

components.description_pt: Concluir de modelos ou ilustrações que organismos são arranjos complexos de sistemas interatuantes
components.description_en: Conclude from models or illustrations that organisms are complex arrangements of interacting systems
components.cc_component_description: Construct an argument using evidence that the body functions as a system of interacting subsystems

cc_matches.description: Use argument supported by evidence for how the body is a system of interacting subsystems composed of groups of cells.
Develop and use a model to illustrate the hierarchical organization of interacting systems that provide specific functions within multicellular organisms.
